title: A differential privacy image classification method and device based on federated learning
assignee: Feima Zhike Information Technology Co ltd

pse.problem: The existing federated learning algorithms have defects such as low model generalization abilities, easy convergence to a local optimum, high communication cost, and lack of practical privacy-preserving methods.
pse.solution_function: The invention proposes a differential privacy image classification method based on federated learning. It uses an adaptive gradient descent algorithm and stochastic gradient descent algorithm to train the local model. The adaptive gradient descent algorithm adjusts the dynamic learning rate automatically, with a standardized first-order Momentum estimation used for bias correction.
pse.solution_structure: The key components are local image sets, adaptive gradient descent algorithm, stochastic gradient descent algorithm, dynamic learning rate range, first-order Momentum estimation, and local parameters.
pse.solution_implementation: Training of the local model involves using the local image set, adaptive gradient descent algorithm, and stochastic gradient descent algorithm. The adaptive gradient descent algorithm adjusts the learning rate automatically based on a standardized first-order Momentum estimation. The bias correction value is estimated for the first-order momentum.
pse.effect: The solution offers improved model generalization abilities by avoiding convergence to a local optimum, reduces high communication cost through parameter interaction and transmission, and provides a practical privacy-preserving method.
